text: Ordinary storage shall use eight-bit bytes and byte addressing. Each supported storable type shall have deterministic value encoding, representation size, required alignment, and allocation size. Sizes/offsets shall be mathematical byte quantities; alignments shall be positive powers of two; allocation shall be at least representation size and a multiple of alignment.
